title: Reuse one canonical definition from separate design contexts
preconditions: Browser fixture has one FeatureFlag System with FlagClient/FlagStore members and checkout/search slides referencing its r1; add a second implementation deck for the manual cross-deck extension.

steps.action: Open the shared System from checkout and search Items; follow FlagStore then return to the System.
steps.expected_result: Both contexts resolve the same System identity, saved member and code without independent definitions.

steps.action: Give Items in two distinct decks different use descriptions and pin the same saved definition; query both Items.
steps.expected_result: Both retain the same canonical identity/revision and their own contextual explanations.

steps.action: Revise the System and reopen its old slide Item.
steps.expected_result: The old r1 remains readable with stale status, without repinning the context.

expected_result: The old r1 remains readable with stale status, without repinning the context.
